text:
marisol: Quick check — planning a quiet rolling sweep to enable the structured-output feature flag at 1% canary across web + mobile tonight. Need a green light on health probes, rollback window, and client gating. @jin, any concerns about older SDKs? :eyes:

jin: can we gate by client version? last time older SDK hit a path that returns bare arrays and broke our parser. prefer client>=1.4.0 filter.

alex: can do. I'll add a compat-rule to flags service: require header `X-Client-Version >= 1.4.0` OR client_id in opt-in list. patching now, ETA ~20m.

anya: what are the health thresholds for auto-disable? suggest p95 latency > 300ms for 5m OR error_rate > 1% triggers instant rollback. also want a manual inspection step before we jump to 5%.

sam: agreed on thresholds. i'll wire up a temporary dashboard and a PagerDuty policy to alert if thresholds hit. i'll also watch memory/kv-cache miss rate since SO can change token patterns.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout for `feature.structured_output` on audience 1% (seed=82457). targeting web-v2 + iOS-frontend; rollout-id=rl-1719212345. status: queued -> in_progress.

marisol: rollout plan: 1% canary -> wait 30m -> if stable and no regressions, bump to 5% after manual signoff. rollback window: first 2 hours auto-enabled health checks, manual rollback permitted up to 6 hours post-start. i'll own manual signoff.

alex: pushed flag config to flags-repo. snippet of the toggle:```json
{
  "flag": "feature.structured_output",
  "audiences": [{"seed_pct": 1, "segments": ["web-v2","ios-frontend"]}],
  "compat_rule": {"min_client_version": "1.4.0", "opt_in_clients": []},
  "health_triggers": {"p95_ms": 300, "err_pct": 1}
}
```

jin: quick CR ping — @alex opened PR #2421 with the compat check. left comments about logging context for mismatched responses. please add `so_compat` tag to logs.

anya: pls also ensure telemetry emits `experiment:structured_output` and `compat_version` so we can slice by client. otherwise slicing will be painful.

sam: monitoring ready. i'll post first status update 5m after rollout starts and then every 10m for the first hour. if any health trigger fires i'll immediately flip the flag off and post notes here.

marisol: perfect. checklist for tonight: client gating (done), flag deployed (alex), dashboards/alerts (sam), telemetry tags (anya), rollback runbook (marisol). @ops-bot please annotate channel when flag flips state. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: acknowledged. will post state changes and a summary message when rollout completes or if a rollback occurs.
